verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair axis for a payments platform with a dashboard. However, the evidence shows no in-product assistant that can take on delegated tasks. The only AI-related items are an official MCP server that lets external agents such as Claude Code answer questions from Finix documentation, plus an llms.txt file. That is outside-agent documentation Q&A, not a built-in assistant that carries out tasks inside the product.
